prompts.baseline:
You are extracting one advertised product from one Saudi retail flyer crop.
The pixels are the only source of truth. Return null when a field is not
directly visible or cannot be assigned unambiguously to the advertised product.

For name_en, follow these rules exactly:
Copy the complete English product title exactly as printed on the package.
Do not remove the brand.
Do not remove the size.
Do not normalize.
Do not correct spelling.
Do not abbreviate.
Return the exact visible text.

Arabic is an independent literal display caption, not a translation. Do not
include promotional phrases, discount percentages, retailer names, or price text
inside either product name.

For price: current_price is the visibly promoted selling price. old_price is only a
visibly crossed-out, WAS, before, or otherwise clearly previous price.

Return exactly one JSON object with:
{
  "name_en": string|null,
  "name_ar": string|null,
  "brand": string|null,
  "current_price": number|null,
  "old_price": number|null,
  "unit": string|null,
  "package_size": string|null,
  "quantity": string|null,
  "package_type": string|null,
  "attributes": string[],
  "confidence": number|null
}

The brand and the size must ALSO be repeated in their own fields. Populating
brand or package_size never permits removing those words from name_en.

package_size must preserve the complete visible expression, such as "6×200 ml",
"10+2", "3 Pack", "900 g", or "1.5 L". quantity is only an explicitly visible
count/multiplier/bonus expression. package_type is only a directly printed form such
as pack, carton, bag, bottle, can, jar, box, or piece. attributes may contain only
short directly visible identity-relevant descriptors such as fresh, frozen, flavor,
cut, model number, or variety.

prompts.caption:
Extract the advertised product from this Saudi retail flyer crop. Use visible pixels only. Do not translate, infer missing text, or count pictured objects.
Read the large flyer product caption first, then the package label. For each language independently, copy the most complete directly printed product title from the flyer caption, or the package if no caption exists. Preserve brand, size, spelling, model, flavour and alternatives in that printed title. Arabic is a literal independent caption, never an English translation. Exclude prices, discounts and retailer text from names.
Return one JSON object with exactly these fields:
{"name_en":string|null,"name_ar":string|null,"brand":string|null,"current_price":number|null,"old_price":number|null,"unit":string|null,"package_size":string|null,"quantity":string|null,"package_type":string|null,"attributes":string[],"confidence":number|null}
Repeat the directly printed brand in brand and complete size expression in package_size even if already in the title. Preserve multipliers, bonus counts, and alternative sizes: 24x18g, 10+2 rolls, 625-645g. quantity is only an explicit sale pack count, multiplier or bonus expression, not the number of pictured alternatives, product age or model. EACH means alternatives sold singly unless a separate explicit pack count is printed. Keep appliance capacity, dimensions, power and wireless frequency out of package_size and unit; these may be visible attributes. For mixed kits or alternative sizes preserve the visible expression without inventing one combined size. current_price is the promoted selling price; old_price requires visible previous/crossed-out price evidence, not a saving amount. Null for unreadable, absent or ambiguous fields. attributes contains only short directly printed identity descriptors. Check every populated field against pixels before returning JSON.

prompts.transcription: Read this retail flyer image literally. Return JSON with arrays english_lines, arabic_lines, size_and_count_lines, brand_lines, price_lines. Copy only directly legible printed text. Keep alternatives, units, multipliers, punctuation, model numbers and price roles. Do not translate, identify from prior knowledge, count pictured packages or calculate totals. Empty arrays for absent evidence.

primary: Paired correct English + Arabic search probes, visible brand and complete printed sale-size evidence. Prices audited separately. No independent annotator. Candidate selected on development, frozen before holdout.
selection: Candidate must improve search evidence without increasing wrong brand/current price or losing complete quantities. Prefer one call and original image when tied. If no clear held-out improvement retain production.
